# 11. Reports are exported as CSV only

Date: 2026-09-05

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-09-05; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「CSV only; I will not maintain a second export format.」 — Mira Example, 2026-09-05

**Options considered:**
- the export feature produces csv only (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

The export feature produces CSV only. No XLSX, PDF or other format is added until this record is superseded.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
